description: This file defines interfaces and notifiers for the PDCP (Packet Data Convergence Protocol) receive side in a 5G/3GPP protocol stack, including classes for handling PDUs, SDUs, control notifications, and security configuration.

classes.name: pdcp_rx_lower_interface
classes.description: Interface for lower layer to pass PDUs into the PDCP receive entity.

classes.name: pdcp_rx_upper_data_notifier
classes.description: Interface for passing SDUs from PDCP to upper layers.

classes.name: pdcp_rx_upper_control_notifier
classes.description: Interface for notifying upper layers of protocol or integrity failures, max count reached, or resume required.

classes.name: pdcp_rx_upper_control_interface
classes.description: Interface for upper layer to configure security, reestablish, buffer SDUs, and control PDU processing.

methods.name: handle_pdu
methods.description: Handle incoming PDU from lower layer.

methods.name: on_new_sdu
methods.description: Notify upper layer of new SDU.

methods.name: on_protocol_failure
methods.description: Notify upper layer of protocol failure.

methods.name: on_integrity_failure
methods.description: Notify upper layer of integrity failure.

methods.name: on_max_count_reached
methods.description: Notify upper layer that max count is reached.

methods.name: on_resume_required
methods.description: Notify upper layer that resume is required.

methods.name: configure_security
methods.description: Configure security parameters for the PDCP receive entity.

methods.name: reestablish
methods.description: Trigger re-establishment with new security config.

methods.name: get_count
methods.description: Get current RX count for status transfer.

methods.name: set_count
methods.description: Set RX count for status transfer.

methods.name: notify_pdu_processing_stopped
methods.description: Notify that PDU processing has stopped.
